messages:
linda.ae: Quick heads-up — Acme Health procurement wants to buy via AWS Marketplace with a 12-month committed spend. They have two must-haves: invoices (monthly, net-30) sent to Acme Holdings (different legal entity), and the private offer must reflect the committed discount exactly so their procurement parser can match line items. Can Deal Desk + Legal confirm feasibility?
eli.dealdesk: We can do an AWS Private Offer to set a custom SKU price reflecting the commit. AWS still issues invoices. Legal needs to review net-30 request; may require Partner Ops signoff with AWS.
neha.f: Procurement insists the monthly invoice include their PO number and the invoice entity must be Acme Holdings even if consumption originates in subsidiary accounts. Can we guarantee one invoice to Holdings?
jonathan.c: AWS billing is account/region-scoped. If usage flows from multiple AWS accounts, AWS will produce separate invoices unless Acme sets up a consolidated payer account. We cannot force AWS to merge invoices on our side.
sam.eng: POC details: ~80k tokens/day for 30 days on hosted API. For production commit we can provision token caps and alerts to control spend. I'll share quota templates.
eli.dealdesk: Plan: 1) AE confirms commit amount + start date; 2) Deal Desk drafts Private Offer with per-SKU pricing; 3) Legal reviews DPA + net-30; 4) AR prepares AWS invoice mapping template. If Acme needs separate legal entity billing, consider two Private Offers or master billing on their side.
neha.f: For AR: we need the Private Offer ID included so we can reconcile AWS invoice lines to our revenue. Can you draft a simple mapping CSV template?
ar.team: Will do — fields: AWS Invoice ID, Marketplace Order ID, Private Offer ID, SKU, quantity, gross, discount, net.
legal-bot: Legal checklist: DPA required; confirm SOC artifacts; net-30 on Private Offer requires Partner Ops approval. Attach Private Offer draft before signature.
procurement-bot: Please file `mp-private-offer` ticket with `procurement-sync` tag and attach PO sample.
linda.ae: I'll ask Acme if they can centralize billing to Holdings (master payer). If not, we'll propose Holdings accept multiple invoices and do internal chargebacks.
e li.dealdesk: If they can't centralize, Partner Ops escalation needed. Two Private Offers (EU + US) possible but more ops work. Also confirm whether procurement needs bundled invoiced line or separate lines per SKU.
jonathan.c: If they require single-line mapping, we may need to create a bundled SKU for the customer in the Private Offer. That's doable but must be coordinated with Partner Ops.
neha.f: I'll collect their PO parser schema so we know required invoice fields.
sam.eng: Sharing quota/alert sample: `alert when usage >= 70% of committed monthly tokens -> slack @linda.ae + email billing@acme.com`. This will keep POC under budget.
linda.ae: Customer proposes $30k/month start 2026-04-01. I'll upload PO example to ticket.
eli.dealdesk: Once we have confirmed commit & SKUs, Deal Desk will draft Private Offer and price worksheet. Legal to review net-30 and DPA. AR to provide mapping guide.
neha.f: Procurement asks: can we make invoice payable to Holdings with net-30 even though AWS invoices? Legal, confirm if we can request invoice instructions in private offer metadata.
legal-bot: We can request invoice instructions, but AWS controls payment terms. Partner Ops must confirm AWS will honor net-30 to buyer.
linda.ae: Thanks. I'll update when I hear back. If they refuse centralization, I'll open Partner Ops escalation.
procurement-bot: Ticket created: `mp-private-offer-1776127890` - attach PO and SOW.
